beaches.name: Whitehaven Beach
beaches.alt: White sand and blue water at Whitehaven Beach
beaches.description: White silica sand meets swirling turquoise water. A little space to slow down and take in the coastline.
beaches.tip: Respect the national park: take your litter with you and leave the sand where it belongs.

beaches.name: Bondi Beach
beaches.alt: The sweeping shoreline and ocean at Bondi Beach
beaches.description: Ocean air, rolling surf, and a lively beachside atmosphere. Discover a different side of Sydney by the sea.
beaches.tip: Swim between the flags and follow lifeguard advice. The coastal walk offers another way to enjoy the view.

temples.name: Angkor Wat
temples.alt: The stone towers of Angkor Wat in Cambodia
temples.description: Discover intricately carved stone galleries and remarkable Khmer architecture in an unforgettable temple setting.
temples.tip: Dress respectfully, cover shoulders and knees, and follow signs around sacred areas.

temples.name: Kiyomizu-dera
temples.alt: The wooden temple buildings of Kiyomizu-dera in Kyoto
temples.description: Wooden architecture and hillside views meet the winding lanes of Kyoto. Find a moment of calm above the city.
temples.tip: Keep voices low in worship areas and follow photography guidance at the temple.

cities.name: Sydney
cities.alt: Sydney Opera House on the Australian harbour
cities.description: Harbour views, distinctive architecture, and neighbourhoods made for wandering. Start with the waterfront and see where it leads.
cities.tip: Explore the harbour on foot or by public ferry for a fresh perspective on the city.

cities.name: Melbourne
cities.alt: The historic Flinders Street railway station in Melbourne
cities.description: Follow the laneways to street art, independent cafés, and a city full of creative energy.
cities.tip: Take time to explore the smaller laneways around the city centre.

cities.name: Tokyo
cities.alt: People crossing the famous Shibuya Crossing in Tokyo
cities.description: A city of contrasts: busy crossings, small side streets, and pockets of quiet. Make room for both the iconic and the unexpected.
cities.tip: Explore one neighbourhood at a time and observe local etiquette on public transport.

cities.name: Kyoto
cities.alt: The scenic Arashiyama area of Kyoto in Japan
cities.description: Riverside walks, mountain scenery, and a slower rhythm. Let the Arashiyama landscape set the pace.
cities.tip: Stay on marked paths and respect residential areas while exploring.
